dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Presence of multiple irregular, high-contrast light-toned ring structures. A primary 'O' shaped structure is visible on the mid-lateral flank with a sharp light-to-dark gradient transition from its perimeter to its darker interior. A secondary 'C' shaped structure is located dorsally, and a third fragmented ring is visible on the anterior dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of solid, high-intensity light-gray pixel clusters lacking internal gradients. These are most concentrated on the lower lateral boundary and the transition area toward the hind flippers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. The vertex formed by the mid-dorsal annulus centroid is approximately 120 degrees relative to the anterior and posterior-lateral centroids.
